reply_text:
I saved the 25 November renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co. to the shared memory and replied to Ilse in the #north-team thread to say it's recorded.

The memory entry says Ilse reported the date and that nobody has checked it against a contract. There's no Brackenwater contract or account folder in the files I can read, so I couldn't confirm it, and I told Ilse that in the reply.

Saving to memory also returned a setup notice: the bot's memory connection can't use 121 operations it should have, and only the brain owner can change that. They can check it by running `gbrain doctor --only grant_new_ops_available --json` on the brain host. It didn't affect this save.
